styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle with a consistent pair scale across the set; single shoe for macro and spec screens; the product is always grounded by a real contact shadow and the metal hardware and upper grain always rendered true to material
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm minimal premium womenswear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm cream beige #F3E9DC, matte plaster white #F7F4EE, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one champagne gold accent #C9A96A; warm tone; one modern geometric sans-serif family with short headlines only and thin warm-gold circular number chips; seamless white packshot backdrop and warm cream paper studio backdrops with matte plaster display blocks; warm soft directional studio light from the front-left with a soft fill card at 5200K, long soft contact shadows and a controlled clean highlight on the gold-tone hardware; single-stroke thin-line icons inside circular outline chips; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle with consistent pair scale, real contact shadows and generous breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented brand marks.

provenance.notes: 源为单张女鞋详情页长图按 800x1200 切成 7 屏逐屏识图（第 5-7 屏版式信息有限，仅提供版式节奏参考）。主产品判定：女款圆头一脚蹬乐福型单鞋，米白色细粒面鞋面，鞋面横跨香槟金色金属链条加编织结饰扣，低粗跟且跟部金属包边收尾，橡胶大底；第 1 屏实拍两鞋置于石膏白方块上、暖米杏斜光背景，第 2-4 屏为要点芯片、参数表、尺码表与编号细节模块。归类依据：源文案标注女码 34-40，第 1-2 屏为女款楦型，故 L2 取「女鞋」。已剥离：店铺二维码与「加入会员」门店标识、被占位块替代的原始模特图、原始中英文文案（含英文字母装饰句与说明文字）、编号橙底方块的具体文案；图内文字一律重建为「」加 {callout}/{selling_point} 占位。尺码区间、材质与参数均为源商品事实，模版中不写死任何数值，参数屏数值以 {selling_point} 短句槽位呈现、材质经 {product_identity_lock} 注入。
